synopsis: Chapter 11 positions OPAL-RT 4DV-SIM as a commercial offering for autonomous and off-highway vehicles, adapted from on-road applications for off-highway and defense use [f9234, f8648, f8697]. The glossary echoes the off-highway and defense user evidence; named users include Safran, Valeo, Michelin and Milrem Robotics, with Milrem’s defense-user evidence explicitly labeled as vendor evidence [f16081, f8649, f8698]. The booklet places 4DV-SIM and OP5707XG2 among data-replay and hardware-in-the-loop offerings and lists CPU/FPGA real-time capability; the glossary specifically identifies OP5707XG2 as combining a CPU and FPGA [f8364, f9236, f16037]. Pricing for both offerings is quote-only, and no latest release was found, leaving procurement cost and release currency unresolved [f8651, f9237, f9238].
